name: Suite — interior shell sections
prompt:
Create ONE detailed architectural component concept sheet, title INT-SUITE-SHELL-001 — Princess suite structural sections. Exactly FOUR spacious numbered cells, one isolated component per cell. Light ivory background. Use only the supplied GEN-26 board for its rose/ivory marble, muted gold star/rose tracery and indigo/rose glass language. It contains halls, not a bedroom: these suite-specific forms are PROPOSED additions. No complete rooms, bed, furniture, plants or celebration dressing. Each cell has one large three-quarter view and small FRONT, REAR/CONTACT and TOP or SECTION diagrams of that exact SAME object. Keep all silhouettes uncropped, lines sharp, real apertures visibly hollow and end seams plain. Put full component ID and name beside object, proposed W × D × H in metres. Ceiling main view must show UNDERSIDE. No dark backing filling arches. No arbitrary arches inserted in plain wall backs. Cornice repeat ends must share identical profiles. Footer: Proposed source-compatible components; exact fit and view parity require modeling review.

INT-SUITE-SHELL-001-S01 — Canopy bed wall niche host. Proposed W,D,H [4.8, 1.2, 6] m. A bed-head WALL NICHE HOST only: solid rose-marble back wall with shallow pointed recess, ivory clustered side pilasters, gold star/rose tracery cornice. Empty bed recess, no bed, canopy fabric, chandelier, plant or floor. Show flat rear mounting face, top horizontal seam and square lateral repeat ends.

INT-SUITE-SHELL-001-S02 — Balcony window and inner reveal bay. Proposed W,D,H [4.8, 1.2, 6] m. A BALCONY DOOR AND INNER REVEAL WALL BAY only: one tall real open pointed doorway, flanked by narrow cobalt/rose glazed lancets in rose-marble wall. Ivory clustered jambs, gold profiles. Door clear height 3.2 m, width 1.8 m proposed. No whole balcony, floor, roof or plants. Show sill depth, hollow opening, rear mounting face and flat lateral end contacts.

INT-SUITE-SHELL-001-S03 — Dressing alcove partition host. Proposed W,D,H [4.8, 0.35, 4.5] m. A DRESSING ALCOVE PARTITION only: one two-sided rose-marble screen wall, ivory pilasters, pointed walk-through arch on its right, shallow empty mirror recess on its left. Gold floral molding. No mirror insert, curtains or furniture. Show true rear face, flat lateral joins and foot contact.

INT-SUITE-SHELL-001-S04 — Quiet suite ceiling and cornice bay. Proposed W,D,H [4.8, 4.8, 1.2] m. A CEILING BAY only, viewed from BELOW as the main image: shallow ivory pointed cross ribs, indigo triangular star panels, gold rib boss, rose perimeter cornice. Detachable square tile with four planar rim contacts. No floor, wall columns or hanging light. Show underside, top support rim and edge section. This is not a complete dome or room.

gap: Missing construction views behind existing room snapshots; generic substrate plus source-compatible interior faces
source_interpretation: GEN-26 supplies architectural grammar only; no bedroom is depicted. Suite-specific hosts and unseen backs are new proposals.
visual_review_notes: Four intended isolated hosts are present; source-compatible rose/ivory marble, indigo inserts and gold molding retained. Ceiling primary view shows underside, and wall bays do not include furniture.
S02 and S03 doorways are visibly open in perspective and front/rear views, but small top diagrams appear to run a solid band across openings. These top diagrams must not be used as cut geometry.
Decorative projection and seam cornices are not proven to terminate at compatible flat ends. S04 top is closed while underside has ribs; internal thickness and fixings require sectional design.
